title: THE ETERNAL REFUGE
STRENGTH FOR TODAY
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: golden light rays through mountain clouds

scenes.a: If you are hesitating to step forward because of the unseen shadows, stay right here.
The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
Lord, anchor this weary heart in the certainty of your presence.
When the path ahead feels uncertain, remind this soul that your everlasting arms remain beneath every step taken in faith.
Drive out every fear and all lingering confusion that clouds the view of your sovereignty.
Grant a settled spirit, knowing that we dwell in the shelter of the Most High, safe from all that troubles us this day.
